initialization: Both models start from scratch with identical shared parameters; no historical trained checkpoint is loaded. The common frozen GPT-2 pretrained base is reused.
limitation: Single-seed V_select development comparison. The two QGAT runs are paired from initialization through the full 100 epochs. Historical GNN100 remains a strong reference, but its first 40 epochs used different physical batching; it is not a new member of this paired run. No V_confirm/test access or quantum-advantage claim.
